verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk or complete export of a user's ELSTER data in open formats. It shows receipts stored in "Meine Belege" (PDF only), electronically delivered notices, a printed transmission protocol, an XML e-invoice viewer, and use of third-party tax software. These are adjacent features or ecosystem channels, not a documented data-export capability, so the verdict stays at none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
